name: 20_200_pips_MQL5_v1
summary: This EA trades EUR/USD once per day at a specific hour (default 18:00) by comparing the open prices of two H1 bars separated by t1 and t2 offsets. If the price difference exceeds a delta threshold, it opens a position with a fixed lot size, a 200-pip take profit, and a 2000-pip stop loss. It only allows one trade per day and resets the trading flag after the session ends.
summary_zh: 该EA每天在指定时间（默认18点）比较两根H1K线的开盘价差值，若差值超过delta阈值则开仓交易。止盈200点、止损2000点，固定手数，每天仅允许交易一次，次日重置交易标志。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于特定时段内H1K线开盘价的差异来判断短期价格偏离方向。入场条件为：在TradeTime指定的小时（默认18点），比较Open[t1]和Open[t2]的开盘价，若Open[t1]比Open[t2]高出delta个点则做空，若Open[t1]比Open[t2]低出delta个点则做多。出场条件依赖固定的止盈200点和止损2000点，盈亏比极低仅为1:10。仓位管理采用固定手数（默认0.1手），无任何动态仓位调整或加仓机制。资金管理方面完全缺失，没有根据账户余额或风险比例计算仓位的功能。该策略的核心假设是特定时段的价格偏离会在短期内回归，但止盈止损比例严重失衡，风险极大。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on comparing the open prices of two H1 bars at a specific time of day to detect short-term price deviation direction. Entry conditions: at the designated TradeTime hour (default 18:00), if Open[t1] exceeds Open[t2] by delta points, a short position is opened; if Open[t1] is below Open[t2] by delta points, a long position is opened. Exit conditions rely on fixed take profit of 200 pips and stop loss of 2000 pips, resulting in an extremely unfavorable risk-reward ratio of 1:10. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (default 0.1 lots) with no dynamic adjustment or scaling mechanism whatsoever. Money management is entirely absent, with no functionality to calculate position size based on account balance or risk percentage. The core assumption is that price deviations at a specific session time will revert in the short term, but the take-profit-to-stop-loss ratio is severely imbalanced, posing extreme risk.

parameters.name: t1
parameters.description_en: Offset index of the first bar

parameters.name: t2
parameters.description_en: Offset index of the second bar

pros: 逻辑简单直观，易于理解和修改
每天仅交易一次，避免过度交易
有每日交易标志控制，防止重复开仓
使用时段过滤，避免低流动性时段交易
pros_en: Simple and intuitive logic, easy to understand and modify
Trades only once per day, avoiding overtrading
Daily trading flag prevents duplicate position opening
Session filter avoids trading during low liquidity periods
cons: 盈亏比极低（1:10），需要超过90%的胜率才能盈利
止损2000点过大，单笔亏损可能致命
无点差过滤，在高点差时段可能遭受滑点损失
没有动态仓位管理，固定手数不考虑账户风险
硬编码ORDER_FILLING_FOK，部分券商可能不支持
未检查OrderSend返回结果是否真正成交
cons_en: Extremely poor risk-reward ratio (1:10), requiring over 90% win rate to be profitable
Stop loss of 2000 pips is excessively large, a single loss can be devastating
No spread filter, susceptible to slippage losses during high-spread periods
No dynamic position sizing, fixed lot size ignores account risk
Hardcoded ORDER_FILLING_FOK which some brokers may not support
Does not verify whether OrderSend result actually resulted in a filled position
improvements: 优化盈亏比，将止损缩小至合理范围或扩大止盈，建议至少1:2以上
添加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和风险比例计算手数
增加点差过滤和新K线检查，避免重复信号和高成本交易
根据券商支持情况动态设置ORDER_FILLING类型
添加回测统计验证策略在不同时段参数下的表现
improvements_en: Optimize risk-reward ratio by reducing stop loss or increasing take profit to at least 1:2 or better
Add dynamic position sizing based on account balance and risk percentage
Add spread filter and new bar check to avoid duplicate signals and high-cost trades
Dynamically set ORDER_FILLING type based on broker support
Add backtesting statistics to validate strategy performance across different time parameters

risk_points: 止损2000点远大于止盈200点，盈亏比1:10极度不合理
无点差过滤，可能在高点差时段开仓导致额外损失
ORDER_FILLING_FOK硬编码可能导致部分券商拒单
未检查交易结果是否真正成交，可能遗漏成交确认
risk_points_en: Stop loss of 2000 pips far exceeds take profit of 200 pips, creating a 1:10 risk-reward ratio that is extremely unfavorable
No spread filter means trades could open during high-spread periods causing additional losses
Hardcoded ORDER_FILLING_FOK may cause order rejection on some brokers
Trade result not fully verified, potentially missing fill confirmation
